headline: Close · 86:34

items.title: 86:34 · Let us review the complete analytical arc
items.detail: Let us review the complete analytical arc we have walked from the dictionary opening to the rebuilt definition.

items.title: 86:42 · We began with the standard dictionary entry
items.detail: We began with the standard dictionary entry for racism and showed that its numbered order encodes an untested causal assumption placing private prejudice ahead of institutional structure.

items.title: 86:52 · We grounded bias in Greenwald and Banaji
items.detail: We grounded bias in Greenwald and Banaji, prejudice in Allport, and discrimination in Fiske's tripartite model, assigning all three to the interpersonal class of human psychology.

items.title: 87:03 · We audited the American racial order against
items.detail: We audited the American racial order against the five-part engineering definition of a system and walked the set-theoretic partitions from Equation 2.1 through Equation 2.4 in Table 2.1 and Figure 2.1.

items.title: 87:15 · The orthographic illusion showed how five tiers
items.detail: The orthographic illusion showed how five tiers project into a binary, and Equation 3.5 showed how the Buffer Class wage rotates between material provision and psychological status.
